🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: very thin sector participation (only 3/11) and narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (Leadership: Narrow — 4/5 top performers in Tech), producing mixed internals rather than a clear risk-on or risk-off signal.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare showing pockets of strength: JNJ (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY. Real Estate modestly positive on the week: 1W: +0.48% | 1M: -4.15% (10 stocks).

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Communication is weakest: NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND. Energy also soft: OXY (1W: -7.33% | 1M: -6.51%) BELOW TREND, XOM (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -4.72%) BELOW TREND. Financials/Consumer names show patchy internals with limited participation.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND, ETN (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology). Style: Growth/Momentum.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND, INTU (1W: -10.33% | 1M: -15.96%) BELOW TREND, TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND, CVS (1W: -8.32% | 1M: -6.46%) BELOW TREND. Weakness is concentrated in Communications and select high-multiple names.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%), AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%), META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%), ETN (1W: +10.75% | 1M: +4.85%), LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%). Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps show 1W/1M mismatch (LRCX, AMAT, ASML on 1W up vs 1M down; CRM, MSFT showing 1W down vs 1M up) — tactical setups, watch for trend break.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Tech is the epicenter of gains but internals are mixed: NVDA (1W: +7.78% | 1M: +4.97%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +1.77% | 1M: +8.89%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: -0.75% | 1M: +4.25%) CORRECTION, CRM (1W: -8.71% | 1M: +15.29%) CORRECTION, LRCX (1W: +10.53% | 1M: -2.66%) RECOVERY. Sector 1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.00% (24 stocks) — leading returns but narrow participation.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials lack leadership breadth despite pockets: JPM (1W: +0.55% | 1M: +0.14%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: +1.15%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.18% | 1M: -1.08%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.83% — limited follow-through, monitor internals.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is selective: JNJ (1W: +1.18% | 1M: +1.28%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +2.34% | 1M: -6.39%) RECOVERY, UNH (1W: -1.56% | 1M: -1.29%) BELOW TREND. Sector 1W: +1.12% | 1M: -2.52% (17 stocks) — patchy demand with idiosyncratic news drivers.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor leading Tech names showing follow-through (INTC, AMD, META) and selective Industrials showing strength (ETN, CAT); reduce exposure to weak Communications and stressed Consumer staples (TMUS, CHTR, CVS). Style: Growth/Momentum but breadth is thin — be selective and monitor the MAJOR divergence for confirmation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: TMUS (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) BELOW TREND, CHTR (1W: -13.95% | 1M: -16.52%) BELOW TREND, NFLX (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (1W: +3.69% | 1M: +6.00%) and Healthcare (1W: +1.12% | 1M: -2.52%) for leadership attempts. BEARISH: Communication (1W: -5.14% | 1M: -5.47%) and Energy (1W: -2.43% | 1M: +0.96%) for downside risk and continued dispersion.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch for follow-through above recent swing highs to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation. AAPL: hold 1M uptrend as support to sustain tech breadth. INTC/AMD: sustained volume and close above this week’s breakout would favor continuation. TMUS/NFLX/CHTR: watch breakdowns on higher volume as confirmation of sector-led weakness.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
CAT (+55): CEO commentary on backlog; price ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +0.14%) — sentiment confirming price. XOM (+55): record output headline; price BELOW TREND (1W: -4.11% | 1M: -4.72%) — bullish news diverging from price (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
NFLX (-55): engagement concerns flagged; price BELOW TREND (1W: -8.67% | 1M: -8.46%) — sentiment confirmed. TMUS (-55): analyst cut cited; price BELOW TREND (1W: -9.64% | 1M: -8.28%) — confirmed weakness. UPS (-45): delivery headwinds; price BELOW TREND (1W: -7.52% | 1M: -7.63%) — confirming downside.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, Growth/Momentum style; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive.  
INTC (1W: +25.30% | 1M: +32.18%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +24.75% | 1M: +31.11%) ABOVE TREND and META (1W: +11.45% | 1M: +35.91%) ABOVE TREND showing clear relative strength.  
Key risk is MAJOR divergence across large caps (LRCX, AMAT, ASML, CRM, MSFT) and thin participation; watch for distribution on bullish headlines (XOM news diverging from price).
